name: kg_set_user_lock
description: Set or clear the user lock (axiom layer) on a KG node. Locking stamps locked_by_user_at and sets confidence_tier='axiom', marking the node's facts as guaranteed-true by the user; every destructive mutator op refuses locked rows. Unlocking clears the stamp and returns confidence_tier to 'provisional'. Only apply on the user's explicit say-so - the lock is the user's guarantee, not the agent's. Audited: requires a non-empty `reason`, refuses no-op transitions, snapshots before/after into kg_revision_log. Pass `dry_run: true` to preview.

inputs.name: node_id
inputs.description: UUID of the node to lock or unlock.

inputs.name: locked
inputs.description: true to lock (axiom), false to unlock (provisional).

inputs.name: reason
inputs.description: Why the lock state is changing. Goes into kg_revision_log.

inputs.name: dry_run
inputs.description: Preview the change; do not commit. Default false.

outputs.description: {ok, revision_log_id, before, after} on commit; {ok, dry_run, before} on dry_run.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for kg_set_user_lock:
- node_id (required): UUID of the node
- locked (required): true to lock as a user-guaranteed axiom, false to unlock
- reason (required): why the lock state is changing
- dry_run (optional): preview only
- finding_id (optional): source finding row id

Example:
{
    "node_id": "node-abc-123",
    "locked": true,
    "reason": "User confirmed the marriage date is correct and asked to pin it"
}
